gloss: to help each other, to cooperate

definitions.gloss: to help each other, to help one another
definitions.explanation: To provide mutual assistance, with each party helping the other.

definitions.gloss: to cooperate, to support each other
definitions.explanation: To work together by providing mutual support.

examples.japanese: {困|こま}った{時|とき}は{助|たす}け{合|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's help each other when in trouble.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{助|たす}け{合|あ}って{宿題|しゅくだい}をした。
examples.english: I did my homework helping each other with my friends.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}は{助|たす}け{合|あ}って{生|い}きていくものだ。
examples.english: Families are meant to help each other and live together.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}の{時|とき}、{地域|ちいき}の{人|ひと}たちが{助|たす}け{合|あ}った。
examples.english: During the disaster, people in the community helped each other.

examples.japanese: {知|し}らない{人|ひと}{同士|どうし}でも{助|たす}け{合|あ}えるのは、{人間|にんげん}のすばらしいところだ。
examples.english: It's a wonderful thing about humans that even strangers can help each other.

examples.japanese: チームで{助|たす}け{合|あ}う。
{仕事|しごと}で{助|たす}け{合|あ}える{仲間|なかま}がいる。
examples.english: I have colleagues I can support each other with at work.

examples.japanese: クラスのみんなで{助|たす}け{合|あ}って{準備|じゅんび}を{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: Everyone in the class cooperated to move the preparations forward.

examples.japanese: {助|たす}け{合|あ}いの{精神|せいしん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている{学校|がっこう}だ。
examples.english: It's a school that values the spirit of cooperation.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}は{人々|ひとびと}が{助|たす}け{合|あ}うことで{成|な}り{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Society is sustained by people cooperating with each other.

notes:
{助|たす}け{合|あ}う is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to help each other.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {助|たす}ける (to help) + {合|あ}う (each other) → to help each other

ASPECT (ている):
{助|たす}け{合|あ}っている indicates an ongoing state of mutual help.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {互|たが}いに{助|たす}け{合|あ}う (help each other mutually)
- {困|こま}った{時|とき}に{助|たす}け{合|あ}う (help each other in times of trouble)
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}いの{精神|せいしん} (spirit of mutual help)

RELATED NOUN:
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}い: mutual help, mutual aid

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH ～{合|あ}う:
- {支|ささ}え{合|あ}う: to support each other
- {競|きそ}い{合|あ}う: to compete with each other
- {話|はな}し{合|あ}う: to discuss with each other

[Register: Neutral]
